Usage: agentcage cage grants revoke [OPTIONS] DOMAIN

  Remove a runtime grant from the overlay (does not touch the baseline).

  The egress hot-reloads the overlay on its mtime poll, so the grant stops being
  effective on the next proxied request — no explicit signal needed.

Options:
  --no-color  Disable colored output.
  --quiet     Suppress progress output (spinners and banners).
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.
